The '''Hyder system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hyder]].
